articles.title: Jarvis leads in South Korea and still has sights set on Race to Dubai title
articles.description: Casey Jarvis could yet ensure the fight for the Race to Dubai title on the European tour is between four golfers. The South African has shot 6-under 65 and leads the Genesis Championship in South Korea by one stroke after the first round. Jarvis is in fourth place in the season-long Race to Dubai standings but a good week will set him up for a shot at the title heading into the final two events of the season. They are in Abu Dhabi and Dubai. Eugenio Chacarra, Patrick Reed and Rory McIlroy are the top three in the standings. Of them, Chacarra is the only player competing this week and he shot 72.
